figures.title: Sparse reconstruction of the inlet waveform
figures.caption: Columns show the single-, three- and seven-vessel networks; rows use one, two and three nested measurement sites. The black curve is the prescribed seven-knot Th inlet. C0 (orange dash-dot) and the neural baseline (blue dashed) infer the same seven amplitudes from paired noisy Th/Fg observations, with noise realization 1 and standard deviation 0.02. Dots indicate parameter knots, not additional observations. All axes use the same limits. Test case 80 is the first held-out ID; the neural curves use seed 42. Only the scored inlet interval 0-0.82 s is shown; the final amplitude is held constant during the remaining concentration simulation to 1.23 s. The temporal inlet is prescribed, not measured from CFD. The additional sites lie at different downstream distances in different topologies, so this is not a controlled vessel-count-only comparison.

figures.title: Known-inlet test errors with uncertainty
figures.caption: Known-inlet whole-network errors for Th, Fg and Fn. Symbols are mean relative L2 errors over 32 held-out inlet cases, weighted within each case by reference volume and trapezoidal time weights over 0-1.23 s. Neural errors are averaged across seeds 42, 43 and 44 within each case before averaging cases; this is not the error of an ensemble prediction. Error bars are 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals for the case mean (3,000 resamples of the 32 complete inlet cases; RNG seed 52703103). Seeds and time samples are not treated as additional independent cases. The three topologies have different fixed geometries and blood conditions.

figures.title: Sparse-inverse test errors with uncertainty
figures.caption: Noisy sparse-inverse errors. Rows show single-, three- and seven-vessel networks. Columns show inlet recovery and reconstructed Th, Fg and unobserved Fn. Th/Fg are observed at 24 times using one, two or three nested sites. Noise has absolute standard deviation 0.02. For each inlet case, errors are averaged over the three paired noise realizations and, for the neural baseline, three training seeds; the 32 case means then receive equal weight. Error bars are 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals using 3,000 resamples of complete inlet cases. Inlet errors use 0-0.82 s and concentration errors use 0-1.23 s. Each column shares the same vertical limits across the three topologies, with zero included. Small horizontal offsets separate overlapping intervals. Connections between the three discrete site counts only guide the eye. Marginal intervals are descriptive; paired method-difference intervals are supplied in paired-differences.csv.
